vocabulary.definition: a person or thing that comes before another of the same kind and leads to its development
vocabulary.example: The discovery of salicin was a precursor to the development of aspirin as a pain reliever.

vocabulary.definition: to fill or pervade with a quality or emotion
vocabulary.example: The medical traditions of ancient cultures were infused with knowledge about natural remedies.

vocabulary.definition: in a way that includes all or nearly all elements or aspects of something
vocabulary.example: Scientists comprehensively investigated the properties of willow bark before identifying salicin.

vocabulary.definition: to combine different elements to form a coherent whole
vocabulary.example: The French chemist synthesized acetylsalicylic acid from salicin, revolutionizing pain relief.

vocabulary.definition: relating to medicinal drugs, or their preparation, use, or sale
vocabulary.example: Bayer was the pharmaceutical company that first marketed aspirin as a pain reliever.

vocabulary.definition: to cause to seem less important or impressive by comparison
vocabulary.example: Newer pain killers overshadowed aspirin's popularity due to their fewer side effects.
